press.desc: A high five. One bright wooden tap on the motif's home note.

card.desc: Picking someone up. A quick upward flick, different from the press.

rec_go.desc: Go! A tiny bright tick right after “one”.

rec_limit.desc: Wrap it up. Two soft taps, five seconds before the end.

msg_start.desc: Unwrapping. A quick sparkle up, then the family voice.

msg_end.desc: That's all. The “Box!” note, warm and settled.

oops.desc: A playful shrug. A bouncy “uh-oh”, two notes down. As loud as the press.

still_trying.desc: Still trying. Two gentle knocks on the same note.

offline.desc: I lost the internet. One soft fall, played once.

connected.desc: I'm here! The airport hug: the motif, its answer, and a sparkle.

all_set.desc: All set! The biggest moment. The connected sound with a full chord at the end.

sent.desc: I'll take it to them. A short whoosh that lifts off into the motif's high notes.

listened.desc: They heard it! The happiest small sound: a sparkle and the “Box!” chord.

card_saved.desc: Card saved. The pick-up flick, then a happy “yes”.
